source: GridGuard gb-corridor-xgb-v2: calibrated XGBoost hourly outage risk in each overhead line's 5 km corridor, trained on SSEN NaFIRS weather-caused overhead-line faults with ERA5 (Open-Meteo) route weather. Area-level proxy, not a verified transmission-line failure probability.
name: Storm Darragh (ERA5 replay)

prediction.target: P(new weather-caused SSEN overhead-line fault report inside the 5 km corridor during [t,t+1h))
prediction.gust_convention: raw ERA5 10 m gust (preceding-hour maximum); no terrain adjustment
prediction.signal_scope: overhead routes only; other branches carry null
